Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes. The reported
mechanism of injury to the right knee is consistent with this type of crash. Initial evaluation documented pain, swelling, and
reduced range of motion. Some examination findings, including localiezd tenderness and a positive effusion sign, support the
reported injury, while other tests, including ligament stability assessment and neurovascular checks, returned normal results. No
prior ijnury or treatment to the same knee is known to this provider. Over the course of care the patient attended 22 visits, which
is somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury pattern; progress was gradual and included physical therapy, activity
modification, and home exercise. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same
services. Patient is currently improving and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued consrevative

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
